obligations.note: match() in apps/baseline-payments/payments/app.py serves GET /compat/account-number/{id} before the route table and returns a view_account_number route with mfa=False. view_account_number is privileged, and _authenticate enforces MFA only when route.mfa is true, so this path is served outside the route table without MFA. No approved exception covers it.
Ticket CHG-26510 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-04, before review, and its component payments.http matches app.py in controls/payments/components.json.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver and not the author Mara Costa, approved a code_review of commit 74fd9836df22f127f04f3261db9b159b53946c1a.
The change is a single commit, and both the code_review and security_review approvals name that head commit.

records/ci/run.json shows the payments suite succeeding on the head commit, and the JUnit report has 172 tests, 0 failures, and 0 skipped, including the registered MFA-1 control test. That pass does not cover the compatibility path added outside the route table.
app.py is security_sensitive under payments.http, and Ines Halvorsen, a security_reviewer who is not the author, approved a security_review of the head commit.
The diff changes only apps/baseline-payments/payments/app.py, which is not under controls/protected-paths.json, so a control_owner approval is not required.
The ticket type is standard and change.emergency is false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The MFA bypass is a deviation from MFA-1 with no approved, unexpired exception scoped to that obligation and payments.http. EXC-0172 is withdrawn and scoped to a mortgage health route; EXC-0141 is SES-1 and expired on 2026-09-08, before the 2026-10-08 review time.
Acceptance-ledger covers for payments (payments.py, audit.py, routes.py) are not in the diff, so those entries have not lapsed. They do not cover the new match() path in app.py.

summary: The change adds a compatibility URL in payments' request matcher that dispatches the privileged view_account_number action with MFA turned off and never consults the route table. That violates MFA-1, and the exception register does not authorize it. Change-ticket, independent approval, security review, and CI records are in order, but they do not cure the control breach, so the change is rejected.
